prompts.icon:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: EvoMyPet square app icon and master brand symbol
Primary request: Create one original, production-ready EvoMyPet symbol that combines an upright mysterious blind-box hatching capsule or incubation pod, an abstract pet paw print integrated through clean negative space, and one small four-point star spark. The mark must represent mystery, collection, and light battle energy without depicting any specific pet.
Scene/backdrop: opaque warm paper-white #FFFDFA square background.
Subject: one centered unified symbol, not three separate clip-art objects; the upright pod must have a distinctive non-circular silhouette and the paw must read clearly at small size.
Style/medium: modern flat vector-friendly logo mark, crisp geometric edges, friendly but not childish, subtle game energy, no 3D, no mockup, no photography.
Composition/framing: exact square composition, centered, strong silhouette, balanced negative space, generous 18 percent outer margin, designed to remain legible at 180x180.
Color palette: lock to EvoMyPet UI tokens only: primary orange #FF7A00, secondary green #4DBB39, neutral ink #36434B, background paper #FFFDFA. No other brand colors.
Text: none.
Constraints: opaque image; no words, letters, pseudo-text, numbers, watermark, signature, border, specific animal, creature face, character, battle lineup, user data, money, challenge details, or third-party asset. Original design only.
Avoid: any red-and-white sphere, circular ball with a horizontal dividing band, equator line, central button-ball motif, lightning-bolt tail, Pokémon or Poké Ball resemblance, TON diamond logo, wallet logo, existing game IP, mascot, 3D rendering, gradients, glossy effects, shadows, decorative clutter.
prompts.share: Edit the approved project-owned Telegram and Open Graph share image. Replace the old brand word on the right with the exact single word EvoMyPet. Preserve the orange and green upright hatching-pod symbol with white paw, warm paper background, ink outlines, geometric rays and star sparks. Keep the visual flat, crisp, opaque, wide and suitable for a 1200x630 final asset. Do not add the gold dragon Bot avatar, any pet, mascot, face, character, extra wording, pseudo-text, number, watermark, signature, third-party logo or existing game IP.
